lag.method_check: METHOD CHECK PASSED: the positive control is detected
lag.limits: units from the same creator are not independent (p-values optimistic); the observed period is short; Instagram times come from the post code (exact), Instagram engagement is not used here

results.name: control: YouTube upload -> YouTube views gained
results.note: must be detected, or the method is broken

results.name: ig_to_yt: Instagram post -> views gained on YouTube videos older than 72 h
ig_to_yt_pure: same, only Instagram posts with no YouTube upload within 24 h
results.note: removes cross-promotion of a new upload

assumptions.planted_trend: normal, mean 0.15, sd 0.15 per neighbour, added to the lift after the event and at placebo dates
assumptions.planted_effect: same for every row, added to the lift after the event only
assumptions.interval: 2.5th percentile of a neighbour bootstrap above zero

sim_lag_power.how: extra attention of s x the creator's own mean rate x 24 h, spread over 12-36 h after each real Instagram post; detection = smallest after-event p < 0.0125 (4 windows, Bonferroni)

claude_text_only_readings.note: Two Claude passes (15 Oct draft, 26 Oct pre-labels) reading only the description or caption, NOT human checks. Text alone cannot hear a spoken sponsorship or see the video, so this is a lower bound on how many are real ads; the one-by-one human checks above are the reference.

label_quality.scoring_rule: tier precision from human checks, shrunk toward pooled 0.973 with 5 pseudo-checks
